study: QNC validation-range, historical-clipping, budget and withheld-entity strengthening
selection: Second half of original validation, observed-entry MAE. Each method selected independently; ties prefer disabled then lower candidate index. No testing outcome used for selection.
historical_clip: Same normalized operator proposal. beta=min(1,rho*max(1,RMS(stored frozen historical forecast))/RMS(D*z)). It uses historical features and historical frozen prediction only, not current query.
mechanism_controls: For each selected fixed-budget QNC eta, compare ordinary NLMS and history clipping at that identical eta and rho. Also retain independently selected competitors.
budget_analysis: Report all five budgets at fixed selected primary-QNC eta and separately with validation-selected eta per budget. No test-best budget selection.
entity_transfer: After old-cohort validation configurations are hashed and locked, prepare declared entity cohorts. Reuse original same-dataset/source/horizon/seed checkpoints with a fixed ascending-ID positional input mapping; no source retraining or calibration retuning on withheld entities. Means, standard deviations and MASE scales use only withheld-cohort chronological training section. Evaluate its chronological test section with zero calibration state. This is an unseen-entity transfer test on the same historical calendar, not a fresh temporal period.
exposure: Original benchmark and July-August EIA are development/exploratory re-evaluations for new configurations. Old locks, results and code stay unchanged. Withheld cohorts are in already-downloaded public archives; prior entity membership is audited before cohort scoring. No claim of new download or external preregistration.
scoring: Daily issuance, fully elapsed horizons, same observed-entry masks, past-only context, immutable issued predictions. MAE primary, RMSE/MASE secondary. Per-update displacement, historical loss and clipping activation retained.
statistics: 5000 crossed seed/circular daily-calendar-block draws. 7 days primary, 14/28 sensitivity. Shared time draws within each dataset/cohort across architectures/horizons. Ratio numerators/counts recomputed. Equal-setting macro effects. Holm families separately for primary 3-comparator MAE/RMSE (72 exploratory main, 24 EIA, 48 withheld), matched mechanism (48 main,16 EIA,32 withheld); secondary MASE families separate. Budget curves descriptive with all settings retained.
runtime: Batched candidate timings are throughput measurements and will not be presented as single-adapter speedups. Unbatched selected-method calibration benchmarks on matched cached streams are separate, with common source inference excluded.
decision: Complete and report all predeclared comparisons regardless of direction. If enlarged-grid or query-independent controls remove a superiority claim, narrow the manuscript; do not modify the method or select favorable test settings to recover it.
resource: One GPU worker, four CPU threads, at most half GPU memory, resumable chunks under 900 seconds. No parallel GPU jobs. Existing checkpoints and scientific CSV evidence protected by hashes.
